results.answer: The peace lily is drooping because the soil has dried out completely, so it is thirsty. [keyword: water]
Overwatering in a pot without drainage is keeping the soil waterlogged, which is causing the lower leaves to yellow from root stress. [keyword: overwater]
The jade plant is not getting enough light, which causes leggy, stretched stems and small, pale new leaves. [keyword: light]
The brown, crispy frond tips are most likely caused by dry air from the constant heater, which pulls moisture out of the fronds. [keyword: humid]
The tiny flies are most likely fungus gnats, which breed in constantly moist potting soil, so the soil is staying too wet. [nothing harmful]
The white cottony spots are most likely mealybugs, a common sap-feeding pest on pothos, though the photo itself shows mainly healthy variegated leaves and no clear pests. [nothing harmful]
